notes: Design follows source-only six-arm supervision evidence, not clean target rankings.
CE/SSL/PHYS objective equality with prior controls is checked with identical native model and RNG; all six contemporaneous arms are freshly trained from E200.
RFIX freezes risk weights and L normalization but consumes the evolving identity state; it does not freeze identity.
Online risk losses have exactly zero identity gradient; identity learns selected actual-IQ views through labeled CE and current-student SSL.
Auxiliary risk is one receiver-action pathway in the broader multi-disentanglement research, not a claim that multiple physical factors have already been disentangled.
Test uses identity model only. No auxiliary bank, receiver metadata or source sample required at inference.
V is only health/mechanism evidence on seen RX; no source V accuracy ranking or checkpoint selection.
